result.document_summary: A part of a code-publisher page reproducing San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 5 anti-discrimination divisions (AIDS/ARC discrimination and sexual orientation/gender identity discrimination) rather than the page's titled algorithmic rent-pricing section.
result.notes: This part contains no rule in the six in-scope categories. The page is headed for the algorithmic rent price-fixing prohibition (SDMC 98.1103), but the text in this part covers only SDMC Division 95 (AIDS/ARC discrimination) and Division 96 (sexual orientation and gender identity discrimination, including housing nondiscrimination in § 52.9604). Those are general anti-discrimination rules, not rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, deposits, application fees, criminal-history or source-of-income screening limits, or algorithmic rent setting. The algorithmic-device prohibition text itself does not appear in this part.
